megatron.backward_relevance: Expert GEMM gradients and reverse dispatch/collectives must preserve tokens-per-expert routing.
megatron.graph_pattern: permuted tokens + tokens_per_expert + permuted_probs -> grouped FC1 -> activation/scaling -> grouped FC2; routing and dispatch/combine are outside compute boundary

dtype: FP8 only on supported TE path
tensor_contract.layout: tokens grouped contiguously by local expert with explicit offsets
tensor_contract.training_inference_distinction: Training saves expert activations and gradients; inference routing/capacity may differ.

distributed_context.expert_parallel: dispatch/combine collectives and local expert ownership
distributed_context.data_parallel: expert/data-parallel gradient groups depend on configuration

replacement_boundary.replace: TEGroupedMLP expert grouped FC1/activation-probability-scaling/FC2 compute for fixed routing metadata
replacement_boundary.fallback_detection: assert TEGroupedMLP/grouped backend identity and invocation count; SequentialMLP is an explicit different baseline, never a silent fallback
